summary: Feature request to rename workflow-based Nexus Operation classes to avoid naming collisions with future standalone Nexus operations. Proposes adding 'workflow' prefix to class names (e.g., NexusClient → NexusWorkflowClient).
userImpact: Users will need to update their code to use renamed Nexus Operation classes as the SDK evolves to support standalone Nexus operations.
rootCause: Current Nexus Operation class names will collide with future standalone Nexus operation classes without proactive renaming.
proposedFix: Add 'workflow' prefix to workflow-based Nexus Operation classes, renaming NexusClient to NexusWorkflowClient.
resolutionDetails: Nexus Operation classes were renamed with 'workflow' prefix to disambiguate from future standalone Nexus operations.
keyQuote: Rename the workflow based Nexus Operation classes pre-emtively to avoid any conflict in the future. The current thought is to add `workflow` so `NexusClient` becomes `NexusWorkflowClient`
